name: ComboBox

props.name: allowCustomValue
props.description: Specify whether or not the ComboBox should allow a value that is not in the list to be entered in the input

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Specify a label to be read by screen readers on the container node 'aria-label' of the ListBox component. / ['aria-label']?: string; /** 'aria-label' of the ListBox component.

props.name: autoAlign
props.description: **Experimental**: Will attempt to automatically align the floating element to avoid collisions with the viewport and being clipped by ancestor elements. Requires React v17+

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `ComboBox` component

props.name: direction
props.description: Specify the direction of the combobox dropdown. Can be either top or bottom.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify if the control should be disabled, or not

props.name: downshiftActions
props.description: Provide a ref that will be mutated to contain an object of downshift action functions. These can be called to change the internal state of the downshift useCombobox hook. **Use with caution:** calling these actions modifies the internal state of downshift. It may conflict with or override the state management used within Combobox. Downshift APIs and internals are subject to change, and in some cases they can not be shimmed by Carbon to shield you from potentially breaking changes.

props.name: downshiftProps
props.description: Additional props passed to Downshift. **Use with caution:** anything you define here overrides the components' internal handling of that prop. Downshift APIs and internals are subject to change, and in some cases they can not be shimmed by Carbon to shield you from potentially breaking changes.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Provide helper text that is used alongside the control label for additional help

props.name: initialSelectedItem
props.description: Allow users to pass in an arbitrary item or a string (in case their items are an array of strings) from their collection that are pre-selected

props.name: inputProps
props.description: Specify native input attributes to place on the `<input>`, like maxLength. These are passed to downshift's getInputProps() and will override the internal input props. https://github.com/downshift-js/downshift?tab=readme-ov-file#getinputprops

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify if the currently selected value is invalid.

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Message which is displayed if the value is invalid.

props.name: itemToElement
props.description: Renders an item as a custom React node instead of a string.

props.name: itemToString
props.description: Helper function passed to downshift that allows the library to render a given item to a string label. By default, it extracts the `label` field from a given item to serve as the item label in the list

props.name: items
props.description: We try to stay as generic as possible here to allow individuals to pass in a collection of whatever kind of data structure they prefer

props.name: light
props.description: should use "light theme" (white background)?

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Used to provide a placeholder text node before a user enters any input. This is only present if the control has no items selected

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether or not the component is read-only

props.name: selectedItem
props.description: For full control of the selection

props.name: shouldFilterItem
props.description: Specify your own filtering logic by passing in a `shouldFilterItem` function that takes in the current input and an item and passes back whether or not the item should be filtered. this prop will be ignored if `typeahead` prop is enabled

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the ListBox. Currently supports either `xs`, `sm`, `md` or `lg` as an option.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `ComboBox` component

props.name: titleText
props.description: Provide text to be used in a `<label>` element that is tied to the combobox via ARIA attributes.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: **Experimental**: will enable autocomplete and typeahead for the input field

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon ComboBox rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
